description: Build a signal-quality monitor daemon that runs every 1800s and computes the distinct-value count for each of the 7 trust framework signals across mcp_signal_scores. Emits a mesh_event severity=WARNING when any signal has < 5 distinct values across the population (the 'bad signal = same signal' gate from PROJECT_GOALS.md defensibility section). Writes per-signal distinct counts to mesh_memory for trend visibility. Pure read; never modifies signal_scores.
